blocks.text: Charles Darwin English sciencedan the. 1831 mein woh His Majesty's Ship Beagle par saainsi muhim mein mahir-e-fitrat ki haisiyat se gaye, yaani duniya ke gird paanch saal ka safar.

blocks.alt: Dashed raasta jo HMS Beagle ke bare paraon ko tarteeb se jorta hai: England (Plymouth, December 1831), Cape Verde Islands, Brazil, Argentina aur Uruguay, Tierra del Fuego, Chile, surkh rang mein Galapagos Islands (September 1835), Tahiti, New Zealand, Australia, South Africa aur wapas England (October 1836). Yeh naqshe ke paimane par nahi.
blocks.caption: HMS Beagle ke bare parao (Figure 24.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: 1831 mein Charles Darwin HMS Beagle par mahir-e-fitrat ki haisiyat se paanch saal ke saainsi safar par duniya ke gird gaye. Jahaz Atlantic paar kar ke South America gaya, us ke mashriqi aur maghribi sahilon par kaam kiya, 1835 mein Galapagos Islands pohancha, phir Tahiti, New Zealand, Australia aur junoobi Africa ke raaste Pacific aur Indian Oceans paar kar ke 1836 mein England wapas aaya. Safar mein, khaas kar Galapagos Islands par, Darwin ke mushahidat ne us ka evolution ka nazariya banaya.
